text:
Elena: Heads-up — Foldr Labs just slid into the yellow renewal-risk band (health 48%). Usage dropped 35% last 14 days after initial onboarding sprint. Thinking a 2-week "education burst" + tailored in-app tours could re-engage before renewals. Any objections to a soft-save that is enablement-first?
Ravi: +1. Can we bundle a small promo credit too? low-touch accounts respond well to that.
Priya: I can run a 2-week onboarding blitz: 3 targeted walkthroughs, 2 office hours, and a checklist email drip. Need the main contact and top 3 workflows they care about.
Elena: Contact is sam@foldrlabs.com. Main workflows: batch ingestion -> vectorize -> semantic search tuning.
Tom: From renewals side, I'd prefer we avoid discount until we see engagement lift, but ok to offer a $250 credit contingent on hitting 70% of onboarding checklist.
Jamal: I can create an in-product tour that highlights batch ingestion and the tuning UI. ETA 48 hours. I'll reuse the snippet we used for VeloXHR.
CS Bot: [health-check] Foldr Labs — last deploy: 2025-02-18, avg latency ok, usage by endpoint: ingest 21%, embed 8%, queries 71% (down 40% day-over-day).
Priya: Draft plan: Day 0 — kickoff email + checklist. Day 2 — guided tour 1 (ingest). Day 4 — tour 2 (embed pipeline). Day 7 — office hour + sample prompts. Day 10 — success review + incentive if checklist >= 70%.
Elena: Email template (quick):
```
Subject: Quick kickoff — foldr labs enablement play
Hi Sam,
We saw your team slow down and wanted to run a short 2-week enablement burst to unblock your ingestion + search tuning.
Plan: 1) brief kickoff, 2) in-app tours, 3) office hour, 4) quick check-in & $250 credit if checkpoints hit.
Are you available Tue/Thu this week?
Thanks, Elena
```
Ravi: Love the contingency credit approach. Can ops flag the account to auto-apply credit once we see checklist events?
Jamal: Yes — I'll add an event hook to emit `onboarding.checkpoint` metrics to the CS dashboard.
Nora: Heads-up — if the play doesn't move health to green by day 12, escalate to a light-touch SE deep-dive and open a QBR slot.
Tom: I'll hold renewals conversation for 2 weeks then. Good to have escalation plan.
Elena: Assigning tasks: Priya (owner of cadence & emails), Jamal (in-app tours + events), Ravi (credit guardrails), Tom (renewal hold), Nora (escalation). I'll ping Sam now.
Priya: I'll draft the email and checklist and post here for quick review in ~90 mins.
Elena: Thanks all — quick wins preferred. Will post results and any replies from Sam in this thread. :sparkles:
